In development · not yet released

Drop the block. Keep the tower standing.

Tilt Tower is a quick physics game for your phone. A crane swings above a wobbling tower: tap once to drop the block and try to stack it so the tower stays balanced. One round takes about a minute.

Contact

Not released yet. There is no store page, release date or final price. The name Tilt Tower is provisional.

One tap

Time one tap to drop the block from the swinging crane. No menus, no tutorial walls.

See the balance

The tower's centre of gravity is visible, so you can see why it wobbles and plan the next block.

A minute a round

Short rounds fit any pause. A daily seed gives everyone the same block order for the day.

At a glance

  • Simple physics balance game, single player.
  • One tap to play; a round lasts about one minute.
  • Free to play, supported by optional rewarded ads.
  • Planned for iOS and Android, in 11 languages.
  • No release date yet.
